data.title: Park Lane Interiors by Vida
data.about:
Park Lane Interiors by Vida is the latest venture by master developer Emaar Properties. Located in Dubai Hills Estate, it comprises 1 to 3-bedroom ultra-luxury apartments. Setting new standards in real estate, Emaar Park Lane Interiors by Vida boasts a blend of elegance and convenience. The property will provide residents with breathtaking views of the 18-course championship golf course and the iconic backdrop of Burj Khalifa. Residents also enjoy proximity to retail options, like the Dubai Hills Mall.

Dubai Hills Estate, the city's green heart, is a meticulously designed, versatile community positioned strategically between Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina. The neighborhood provides excellent connectivity to the city's major roads and attractions.

characteristics_module.title: The project by Emaar offers a blend of elegance and comfort.
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Residents will enjoy breathtaking views of the greenery and picturesque landscapes.
  • The property will feature a large podium level dedicated to amenities offering a holistic and luxurious lifestyle.
  • Fully curated and spacious 1, 2 and 3-bedroom residences.
  • Emaar is the developer of Park Lane Interiors by Vida. The development company is known for its remarkable properties and architectural excellence.

location_tile.title: Enjoy a vibrant lifestyle in Dubai Hills Estate
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Emaar Park Lane Interiors by Vida Apartments is in Dubai Hills Estate, a premier residential and lifestyle destination. The master-planned development spans over 11 million sq. ft. and features a mix of residential neighborhoods, commercial hubs, retail centers, parks, and recreational facilities.

The community provides residents a harmonious blend of luxury, convenience, and natural beauty. The vibrant community also houses reputable schools, healthcare facilities, and other essential amenities.

  • 12 minutes - Meydan Race Course
  • 12 minutes - Mall of the Emirates
  • 12 minutes - Dubai Marina
  • 15 minutes - Burj Khalifa
